name: hosted-webhooks
description: Hosts the package's own HTTP routes and receives Stripe deliveries at a token URL the reactor serves.

config.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
config.description: The signing secret Stripe shows when a webhook endpoint is created. Resolved server-side in policyFor and handed to core as `verify.secret`; it is never written into document state and never reaches the browser. One value for the whole deployment, which fits one Stripe account: every subscription's endpoint verifies against it. A deployment serving several accounts overrides the subgraph's secretFor to resolve a secret per document, so a leak from one cannot forge another's deliveries.
